an2.32:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmī ti.
an2.32:1.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an2.32:2.3: Asabbhi h' etaṃ bhikkhave upaññātaṃ yadidaṃ akataññutā akataveditā.
an2.32:2.4: Kevalā esā bhikkhave asappurisabhūmi yadidaṃ akataññutā akataveditā.
an2.32:2.5: Sappuriso ca kho bhikkhave kataññū hoti katavedī.
an2.32:2.6: Sabbhi h' etaṃ bhikkhave upaññātaṃ yadidaṃ kataññutā kataveditā.
an2.32:2.7: Kevalā esā bhikkhave sappurisabhūmi yadidaṃ kataññutā kataveditā ti. 2.
an2.33:1.4: Ekena bhikkhave aṃsena mātaraṃ parihareyya ekena aṃsena pitaraṃ parihareyya vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī. So ca tesaṃ ucchādana-parimaddana-nahāpana-sambāhanena <patijaggeyya*>
an2.33:1.5: te pi tatth' eva muttakarīsaṃ cajeyyuṃ na tveva bhikkhave mātāpitunnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti patikataṃ vā.
an2.33:1.6: Imissā ca bhikkhave mahāpaṭhaviyā pahūta-sattaratanāya mātāpitaro issarādhipacce rajje patiṭṭhāpeyya na tveva bhikkhave mātāpitunnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti patikataṃ vā.
an2.33:1.8: Bahukārā bhikkhave mātāpitaro puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāro.
an2.33:1.9: Yo ca kho bhikkhave mātāpitaro assaddhe saddhā-sampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti dussīle sīla-sampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti maccharī cāga-sampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti duppaññe paññā-sampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti ettāvatā kho bhikkhave mātāpitunnaṃ katañ ca hoti patikatañ ca atikatañ cā ti. 3.
an2.34:1.1: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an2.34:1.3: Kiriyavādī cāhaṃ brāhmaṇa akiriyavādī cā ti.
an2.34:1.4: Yathā kathaṃ pana bhavaṃ Gotamo kiriyavādī ca akiriyavādī cā ti?
an2.34:2.1: Akiriyaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa vadāmi. Kāyaduccaritassa vacīduccaritassa manoduccaritassa anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ akiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an2.34:2.2: Kiriyañ ca kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa vadāmi. Kāyasucaritassa vacīsucaritassa manosucaritassa anekavihitānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ kiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an2.34:2.3: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa kiriyavādī ca akiriyavādī cā ti.
an2.34:3.1: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama . . . pe . . . Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti. 4.
an2.35:1.1: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an2.35:1.2: Kati nu kho bhante loke dakkhiṇeyyā kattha ca dānaṃ dātabban ti?
an2.35:1.5: Ime kho gahapati dve loke dakkhiṇeyyā ettha ca dānaṃ dātabban ti.
an2.35:2.2: idaṃ vatvā Sugato athāparaṃ etad avoca satthā:
an2.36:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an2.36:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Sāriputto Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde.
an2.36:1.4: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an2.36:1.6: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an2.36:1.8: ca āvuso puggalaṃ desissāmi bahiddhāsaññojanañ ca,
an2.36:1.9: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmī ti.
an2.36:1.10: Evaṃ āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an2.36:2.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkha-saṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāra-gocara-sampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an2.36:2.3: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ uppajjati.
an2.36:2.4: So tato cuto āgāmī hoti āgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:2.5: Ayaṃ vuccati āvuso ajjhattasaññojano puggalo āgāmī āgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:3.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an2.36:3.3: So aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an2.36:3.4: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ uppajjati.
an2.36:3.5: So tato cuto anāgāmī hoti anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:3.6: Ayaṃ vuccati āvuso bahiddhāsaññojano puggalo anāgāmī anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti . . . pe . . . samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an2.36:4.2: So kāmānaṃ yeva nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
an2.36:4.3: So bhavānaṃ yeva nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
an2.36:4.6: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ uppajjati.
an2.36:4.7: So tato cuto anāgāmī hoti anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:4.8: Ayaṃ vuccati āvuso bahiddhā-saññojano puggalo anāgāmī anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:5.1: Atha kho sambahulā samacittā devatā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā devatāyo Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
an2.36:5.2: Eso bhante āyasmā Sāriputto Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde bhikkhūnaṃ ajjhattasaññojanañ ca puggalaṃ deseti bahiddhāsaññojanañ ca.
an2.36:5.4: Sādhu bhante Bhagavā yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an2.36:5.6: Atha kho Bhagavā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evam eva Jetavane antarahito Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde āyasmato Sāriputtassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
an2.36:5.8: Āyasmā pi kho Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an2.36:5.9: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
an2.36:6.1: Idha Sāriputta sambahulā samacittā devatā yen' āhaṃ ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Sāriputta tā devatā maṃ etad avocuṃ:
an2.36:6.2: Eso bhante āyasmā Sāriputto Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde bhikkhūnaṃ ajjhattaṃ saññojanañ ca puggalaṃ deseti bahiddhāsaññojanañ ca.
an2.36:6.4: Sādhu bhante Bhagavā yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an2.36:6.5: Tā kho pana Sāriputta devatā dasa pi hutvā vīsatim pi hutvā tiṃsatim pi hutvā cattārīsam pi hutvā paññāsam pi hutvā saṭṭhim pi hutvā āraggakoṭi-nittuddanamatte pi tiṭṭhanti na ca aññamaññaṃ vyābādhentī ti.
an2.36:6.6: Siyā kho pana te Sāriputta evaṃ assa:--
an2.36:6.7: tattha nūna tāsaṃ devatānaṃ tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ yena tā devatā dasa pi hutvā vīsatiṃ pi hutvā tiṃsatim pi hutvā cattārīsam pi hutvā . . . pe . . . āraggakoṭinittuddanamatte pi tiṭṭhanti na ca aññamaññaṃ vyābādhentī ti.
an2.36:6.8: Na kho pan' etaṃ Sāriputta evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ:--
an2.36:6.9: Idh' eva Sāriputta tāsaṃ devatānaṃ tathā cittaṃ . . . pe . . . vyābādhenti.
an2.36:6.13: Santindriyānaṃ hi vo Sāriputta santamānasānaṃ santaṃ yeva kāyakammaṃ bhavissati santaṃ vacīkammaṃ santaṃ manokammaṃ
an2.36:6.14: santaṃ yeva upahāraṃ upaharissāma sabrahmacārisū ti. Evaṃ
an2.36:6.16: Anassuṃ kho Sāriputta aññatitthiyā paribbājakā ye imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ na assosun ti. 6.
an2.37:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahākaccāyano Varaṇāyaṃ viharati Kaddamadahatīre.
an2.37:1.3: Atha kho Ārāmadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo yen' āyasmā Mahākaccāyano ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Mahākaccānena saddhiṃ sammodi
an2.37:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Ārāmadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etad avoca:--
an2.37:1.5: Ko nu kho bho Kaccāna hetu ko paccayo yena khattiyā pi khattiyehi vivadanti brāhmaṇā pi brāhmaṇehi vivadanti gahapatikā pi gahapatikehi vivadantī ti? Kāmarāga-vinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhānajjhosāna-
an2.37:1.6: hetu kho brāhmaṇa khattiyā pi khattiyehi vivadanti brāhmaṇā pi brāhmaṇehi vivadanti gahapatikā pi gahapatikehi vivadantī ti.
an2.37:2.1: Ko pana bho Kaccāna hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇā pi samaṇehi vivadantī ti? Diṭṭhirāga-vinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhānajjhosāna-
an2.37:2.2: hetu kho brāhmaṇa samaṇā pi samaṇehi vivadantī ti.
an2.37:3.1: Atthi pana bho Kaccāna koci lokasmiṃ yo imañ c' eva kāmarāga-vinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto. Idañ ca diṭṭhirāgavinivesa . . . samatikkanto ti.
an2.37:3.2: Atthi brāhmaṇa lokasmiṃ yo imañ c' eva kāmarāgavinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto idañ ca diṭṭhirāga-vinivesa-vinibandha-paligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto ti.
an2.37:4.1: Ko pana so bho Kaccāna lokasmiṃ yo imañ c' eva kāmarāgavinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto idañ ca diṭṭhirāga-vinivesa-vinibandha-paligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto ti?
an2.37:4.2: Atthi brāhmaṇa puratthimesu janapadesu Sāvatthi nāma nagaraṃ.
an2.37:4.3: Tattha so Bhagavā etarahi viharati arahaṃ sammā sambuddho.
an2.37:4.4: So hi brāhmaṇa Bhagavā imañ ca kāmarāgavinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto idañ ca diṭṭhirāga-vinivesa-vinibhanda-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto ti.
an2.37:5.1: Evaṃ vutte Ārāmadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇaṃ jānu-maṇḍalaṃ puthuviyaṃ nihantvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesu:
an2.37:6.1: Namo tassa Bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa !
an2.37:7.1: Namo tassa Bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa !
an2.37:8.1: Namo tassa Bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa !
an2.37:9.1: Yo hi so Bhagavā imañ c' eva kāmarāga-vinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto idañ ca diṭṭhirāga . . . samatikkanto ti.
an2.37:10.2: seyyathāpi bho Kaccāna nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī ti. Evam evaṃ bhotā Kaccānena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an2.37:10.3: Esāhaṃ bho Kaccāna taṃ Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca.
an2.37:10.4: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti. 7.
an2.38:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahākaccāno Madhurāyaṃ viharati Gundāvane.
an2.38:1.2: Atha kho Kaṇḍarāyano brāhmaṇo yen' āyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Mahākaccānena saddhiṃ . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Kaṇḍarāyano brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etad avoca:--
an2.38:1.3: Sutam me taṃ bho Kaccāna na samaṇo Kaccāno brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo-anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetī ti.
an2.38:1.5: na hi bhavaṃ Kaccāno brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo-anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetī ti
an2.38:1.6: tayidaṃ bho Kaccāna na sampannam evā ti.
an2.38:2.1: Atthi brāhmaṇa tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammā sambuddhena vuddha-bhūmi ca akkhātā daharabhūmi ca.
an2.38:2.2: Vuddho ce pi brāhmaṇa hoti āsītiko vā nāvutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā so ca kāme paribhuñjati kāmamajjhe vasati kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhati kāmavitakkehi khajjati kāmapariyesanāya ussukko
an2.38:2.3: atha kho so bālo thero tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an2.38:2.4: Daharo ce pi brāhmaṇa hoti yuvā susukāḷakeso bhaddena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā
an2.38:2.5: so ca na kāme paribhuñjati na kāmamajjhe vasati na kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhati na kāmavitakkehi khajjati na kāmapariyesanāya ussukko
an2.38:2.6: atha kho so paṇḍito thero tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī ti.
an2.38:3.1: Evaṃ vutte Kaṇḍarāyano brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā daharānaṃ sudaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde sirasā vandati:
an2.38:4.1: Abhikkantaṃ bho Kaccāna . . . pe . . . Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti. 8.
an2.39:1.1: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye corā balavanto honti rājāno tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti:
an2.39:1.2: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye rañño na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ
an2.39:1.3: brāhmaṇa-gahapatikānam pi tasmiṃ samaye na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātum vā bāhirāni vā kammantāni paṭivekkhituṃ.
an2.39:1.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye pāpabhikkhū balavanto honti pesalā bhikkhū tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti:
an2.39:1.5: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye pesalā bhikkhū tuṇhībhūtā tuṇhībhūtā vā saṅgha-majjhe saṅkasāyanti paccantime vā janapade bhajanti:
an2.39:1.6: tayidaṃ bhikkhave hoti bahujanāhitāya bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an2.39:2.1: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye rājāno balavanto honti corā tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti:
an2.39:2.2: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye rañño phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ
an2.39:2.3: brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ pi tasmiṃ samaye phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā bāhirāni vā kammantāni paṭivekkhituṃ.
an2.39:2.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye pesalā bhikkhū balavanto honti tasmiṃ samaye pāpabhikkhū dubbalā honti:
an2.39:2.5: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye pāpabhikkhū tuṇhībhūtā tuṇhībhūtā vā saṅgha-majjhe saṅkasāyanti yena vā pana tena papatanti:
an2.39:2.6: tayidaṃ bhikkhave hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan ti. 9.
an2.40:1.1: Dvinnāhaṃ bhikkhave micchāpaṭipattiṃ na vaṇṇemi gihissa vā pabbajitassa vā.
an2.40:1.2: Gihī vā bhikkhave pabbajito vā micchāpaṭipanno micchā-paṭipattādhikaraṇa-hetu nārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
an2.40:2.1: Dvinnāhaṃ bhikkhave sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi gihissa vā pabbajitassa vā.
an2.40:2.2: Gihī vā bhikkhave pabbajito vā sammāpaṭipanno sammāpaṭipattādhikaraṇa-hetu ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan ti. 10.
an2.41:1.1: Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū duggahītehi suttantehi vyañjana-patirūpakehi atthañ ca dhammañ ca paṭibāhanti te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanāhitāya paṭipannā bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ
an2.41:1.2: bahuñ ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū apuññaṃ pasavanti te c' imaṃ saddhammaṃ antaradhāpenti.
an2.41:2.1: Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū suggahītehi suttantehi vyañjanapatirūpakehi atthañ ca dhammañ ca anulomenti te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
an2.41:2.2: bahuñ ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū puññaṃ pasavanti te c' imaṃ saddhammaṃ ṭhapentī ti.
